Definition: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
BiblicalUsage: Ephraim = "double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful"; 1) second son of Joseph, blessed by him and given preference over first son, Manasseh; 2) the tribe, Ephraim; 3) the mountain country of Ephraim; 4) sometimes used name for the northern kingdom (Hosea or Isaiah); 5) a city near Baal-hazor; 6) a chief gate of Jerusalem
